item.title: EA-37B Flew Along Kaliningrad Border As Part Of “Specialized” Recon, EW Flight Package
item.summary: The USAF's new EA-37B Compass Call electronic warfare jet was part of a larger NATO package that flew along the doorstep of Russia's strategic military outpost. The post EA-37B Flew Along Kaliningrad Border As Part Of “Specialized” Recon, EW Flight Package appeared first on TWZ .
